summary: Male motorist drove off Red Mountain Pass (U.S. 550) early Thursday morning; vehicle plunged hundreds of feet below the road into the river; he spent hours yelling for help until a local CDOT driver, Dack Klein, came across the debris field and heard his cries. The pass was closed during the rescue. Ouray County Sheriff's Office, Ouray Volunteer Fire Department, Ouray Mountain Rescue Team, Colorado State Patrol, Ouray County EMS, and Ouray PD responded; he was transported to Fellin Park and flown by CareFlight to Montrose hospital.
location: Red Mountain Pass (U.S. 550), vehicle in the river below the road
responding_agency: Ouray County Sheriff's Office + Ouray Volunteer Fire Department + Ouray Mountain Rescue Team + Colorado State Patrol + Ouray County EMS + Ouray Police Department
notes: iHeart/CBS4: injuries not specified; victim heard yelling for hours before CDOT's Dack Klein found him; transported to Fellin Park, CareFlight of Montrose to Montrose hospital.
